Plotting connectogram vizConnectogram() function can take input vectors following lengths: 30135 — derived 246x246 FC matrices generated using Brainnetome atlas 23871 — derived 219x219 FC matrices generated using Schaefer-200 atlas + 19 subcortical regions freesurfer subcortical segmentations. typically used NIMH datasets 7021 — derived 119x119 FC matrices generated using Schaefer-100 atlas + 19 subcortical regions freesurfer subcortical segmentations. typically used ABCD dataset 4005 — derived 90x90 SC matrices generated using AAL-90 atlas number nodes display connectogram plot automatically determined length input vector. first example, generate sparse vector 23871 random numbers ranging -1 1 use vector input vector simulate results derived running network-based statistics 219x219 FC matrices. vector ‘sparse’ contains non-zero values. see important later line, frequency numbers c(1,0, -1) appearing vector corresponds specified probabilities prob = c(0.001, 0.998,0.001). Next, call upon vizConnectogram() function cloud, run results vector code output following FC_219.png image working directory. note distribution nodes Schaefer-100 Schaefer-200 parcellation schemes symmetrical across hemispheres.  B. Customizing optional parameters vizConnectogram() allows customize following visual parameters hot : color code name color positive edges cold : color code name color positive edges edgethickness: thickness edge links; default thickness set 0.8 colorscheme: vector 8 color codes/names FC matrices 7 color codes/names SC matrices next example, simulate results derived brainnetome atlas (246x246 FC matrices; length input vector=30135) also play around color-related parameters, code output following FC_246.png image working directory.  can see can little difficult differentiate network nodes belong colors similar. pay attention choice colors adjust colorscheme parameter C. Excessive cluttering connectograms ideal visualizing sparse FC/SC matrices. many non-zero values matrices, connectogram can become cluttered consequently difficult interpret. ’s example:  can make look little less cluttered reducing thickness edge links. Note default value 0.8 effective edges nicely bundled , isn’t case . tried reduce thickness edge links doesn’t help much, perhaps use chord diagram instead C. Multiple connectograms necessary, can plot multiple connectograms fit nicely grid format.

title: vizNetConnectogram — vizNetConnectogram
text: Creates circular network connectogram (chord diagram) data frame connectivity results, visualizing edge weights signs using color transparency. Node self-connections (diagonal elements) highlighted node border. Optionally saves plot PNG file. Row names results must follow pattern "nodeA nodeB". Self-connections (== ) extracted colour shade node borders: diagonal values > 1 border drawn hot; < 1 drawn cold. diagonal entries removed igraph graph object constructed. Edge colour encodes sign (hot = positive, cold = negative) edge transparency encodes absolute magnitude. function relies igraph, ggraph, ggplot2.
